title: 26. Chernobyl — How It Happened
summary: MIT 22.01 lecture by Michael Short explaining the Chernobyl accident technically, including RBMK reactor positive feedback, xenon poisoning and the cascade of human errors during the test.
why: Recommended as the detailed technical account of exactly what happened at Chernobyl.

quote.text: This is a presentation to students by an MIT professor that goes over exactly what happened, the sequence of events, mistakes made, and so on.
